description: OFAT ablation schema companion. E2.2.2 combined a prompt-level global-consistency rule (factor A), a prompt-level complete-state rule (factor B), and a schema-level repaired_concepts.minItems=2 constraint (factor C) into ONE arm and could not tell which factor did the work. E2.2.3 keeps A and B as PROMPT TEXT only (see _gen_prompts.py's ARM_RULES) and keeps C as a pure SCHEMA difference -- the two variants below are the only schema-level lever in this experiment. As in every prior experiment in this series, this file is a frozen documentation/provenance artifact only: _gen_prompts.py and evaluate.py never import it. The actual JSON Schema object for whichever variant an arm uses must be manually transcribed into the ad-hoc Workflow-tool script at execution time, exactly as the single schema in E2.2.1/E2.2.2's decision_schema.json was transcribed into their Workflow scripts.

no_minitems.name: client_decision_v4_ofat_no_minitems
no_minitems.description: Used by A_ONLY and B_ONLY. Byte-identical to E2.2.1's client_decision_v2_vocab_exposed schema (repaired_concepts is an unconstrained-length array/null) -- i.e. NO minItems constraint. Factor C is deliberately absent here so these two arms isolate only their respective prompt rule.

minitems_2.name: client_decision_v4_ofat_minitems2
minitems_2.description: Used by C_ONLY only. Byte-identical to E2.2.2's client_decision_v3_invariants_enforced schema -- same as no_minitems but with repaired_concepts.minItems=2 (hardcoded to dir1_directed's exact 2-concept input; fixture-specific, not general purpose). This is the ONLY lever in this arm: no GLOBAL_CONSISTENCY_RULE or COMPLETE_STATE_RULE text in the prompt (see _gen_prompts.py's ARM_RULES['C_ONLY'] = (VOCAB_HINT,)).
